question: Which direction points toward the closest nature reserve relative to New Bedford Fishing Heritage Center, New Bedford, MA?
sql:
SELECT *, degrees(ST_Azimuth(ST_GeomFromText('POINT (-70.92354 41.636177)',4326)::geography, pois.geometry)) AS angle  FROM pois
WHERE leisure = 'nature_reserve'
ORDER BY geometry <-> ST_GeomFromText('POINT (-70.92354 41.636177)',4326)::geography ASC
LIMIT 1;
